title: Media God Fire TV
message: Fire TV 1.4.23 adds the full playback resilience upgrade: quality-preserving 4K failover, HDR/Dolby Vision base-layer rescue, pre-play stream validation, 23.976/24/25/50/60-style refresh-rate matching, a selectable LibVLC audio track control, richer native diagnostics, and device-specific codec/reliability learning.
